summary: 已完成第一个 Foundation Change 的 Flowkit proof-based Explore，并生成可供独立 Reviewer 审阅的 explore.md：确认 semantic Change id 单一身份、authority 与 execution role 分离、Owner decision 为显式不可推断事实；第一 Change 只建立 authority/identity 与 Delivery/Change 基础 fail-closed contract，不提前实现 Action lifecycle / Run persistence / Policy。

proofEvidence.fact: flowkit-next 当前没有 production implementation；Source layering 明确留到 Foundation 后续 Change 物化。
proofEvidence.implication: 本 Change 应从纯 domain contract 起步，不能假设 candidate lifecycle runtime 已存在。

proofEvidence.fact: 当前没有 formal tests；初始化只预留 tests 结构。
proofEvidence.implication: Proposal 必须为新增 domain rules 定义首批 targeted unit tests，而不能声称已有测试护栏。

proofEvidence.fact: 第一个 Change id 为 establish-lifecycle-authority-and-identity-contracts，dependsOn=[]，输出限定为 authority/identity domain contract 与 role separation invariants。
proofEvidence.implication: 该 Change 可以独立激活；不得吸收后续 Run persistence、Policy、CLI 或 OpenSpec adapter 工作。

proofEvidence.fact: OpenSpec 是 formal Change authority；Change identity 是 semantic id；group 仅组织元数据；Owner/Reviewer/Verification/Git authority 必须分离。
proofEvidence.implication: 新 domain type 必须遵守 semantic-id-only 与 authority separation，不能引入 group lifecycle 或第二份 Change identity。

proofEvidence.fact: project-owned Standard Action Skills 目前只有 reserved README，没有 explore proof skill。
proofEvidence.implication: 本次 proof 是 bootstrap 外部治理行为；后续若需要 project-owned proof skill，必须由正式 Change 另行设计/接受。

proofEvidence.fact: 旧 Flowkit 的 ChangeSummary / Change 同时持有 key 与 id；Role 为 owner|author|reviewer；Verification 是独立 domain evidence。
proofEvidence.implication: 不得把 key+id 双重 Change identity 原样迁移；需要显式区分 actor role 与独立 Verification authority。

proofEvidence.fact: 旧 Flowkit OwnerDecisionRecord 已区分 create-delivery/create-change/activate-change 与 authorize-apply/archive/checkpoint 等显式 Owner decision；旧 ChangeCreateInput 仍要求 key+id。
proofEvidence.implication: 可复用“Owner decision 是 durable 显式事实”的方向，但 identity contract 必须去掉 key。

proofEvidence.fact: 旧 Standard Change Action 的执行 role 只有 author/reviewer；owner 不执行 Standard Action；explore 的 terminal contract 不允许 Git checkpoint output。
proofEvidence.implication: Owner authority 与 Action execution role 必须概念分离；Explore completion 不能推导 commit/checkpoint 权限。

proofEvidence.fact: 旧结构状态表只定义 planned→active/cancelled、active→completed/cancelled；Owner authorization、dependency、Verification 等语义 precondition 明确留给 Policy。
proofEvidence.implication: 本 Change 可冻结结构状态与 fail-closed identity validation，但不能提前实现后续 Policy Change 的 semantic eligibility。

proofEvidence.fact: Planned architecture 将 Lifecycle Domain 标为独立新增组件，sublabel=authority / identity / Action state，并把 Policy、Execution、Persistence 分为独立后续组件。
proofEvidence.implication: 第一 Change 应建立最小 shared domain vocabulary 与 authority identity，不应把 Policy/Execution/Persistence 实现耦合进来。

findings.title: Change identity 必须只有 semantic id
findings.decision: Flowkit-next 的 Change canonical identity 只使用 changeId/semantic id；group 不是 identity，禁止恢复旧 key+id 双轨。

findings.title: Authority 与 execution role 必须分层
findings.decision: Owner 是显式 authority source；Author/Reviewer 是 Standard Action execution roles；Verification 是独立 evidence authority，不伪装成 Reviewer 或 Owner。

findings.title: Owner decisions 必须显式、可引用、不可由终态推断
findings.decision: 至少 create-delivery/create-change/activate-change 等 lifecycle fact 与后续 authorize-* 必须具有 deterministic ref + sourceRef；Review PASS / Verification PASS / Run terminal 不产生 Owner authority。

findings.title: 第一 Change 不拥有 Action lifecycle implementation
findings.decision: 本 Change 只定义 Action identity/role vocabulary 所需的最小部分；prepared/resumed/terminal/current Action invariant 留给 establish-action-lifecycle-domain-contracts。

findings.title: 结构状态与 Policy semantic eligibility 分离
findings.decision: 可定义 Delivery/Change state enum 与结构 transition/fail-closed validation；dependencies completed、授权是否足够、下一 Action 计算留给后续 Policy。

findings.title: AGENTS.md 当前仍含初始化期动态状态文本
findings.decision: 不得继续把动态 Delivery/Change 状态写进 AGENTS.md。Proposal 应明确是否在本 Change 清理这些初始化期动态陈述，仅保留长期 authority rules；Explore 本身不修改 AGENTS.md。

findings.title: Flowkit Explore Skill v2 尚未 vendored 到 flowkit-next
findings.decision: 已有 Flowkit Explore Skill v2 作为既定外部 Author guidance，并要求生成 explore.md；当前 flowkit-next 仓库尚未 vendored/productized 该 skill。本 Run 按 v2 contract 执行，但不得在本 Change 顺带新增通用 Skill。

proposalConstraints: semantic Change id only; no key alias or A1/B1 identity layer
Owner authorization is explicit durable fact with deterministic ref/sourceRef
Owner / Author / Reviewer / Verification responsibilities remain distinct
Standard Action completion never implies Git checkpoint authority
first Change may define Delivery/Change structural states and identity validation but not Policy semantic eligibility
do not implement prepared/resumed/terminal/current Action lifecycle here
do not implement Run/Result persistence, Policy, CLI, managed toolchain, OpenSpec adapter or Git checkpoint logic here
fail closed on malformed/unknown identity and authority literals
new behavior must receive targeted unit tests because current tests are empty
openQuestionsForProposal: 是否由本 Change 顺手移除 AGENTS.md 中已经过时的初始化动态状态段，只保留稳定 authority rules？若修改，应严格限定为 guidance cleanup，而不是建立第二套 lifecycle truth。
Role 类型是否采用 ActorRole(owner|author|reviewer) + ActionExecutionRole(author|reviewer) 两层，还是仅保留一个 Role 并通过 helper 排除 owner？Proposal 需要选择单一形式，避免旧模型语义含混。

nextBoundary.reason: Delivery 01 candidate Policy 尚未实现；按外部治理流程，Explore payload 应先交独立 Reviewer。

notes: OpenSpec 1.10.0 upstream new-change implementation verified: new change scaffolds .openspec.yaml with schema + local creation date before artifacts.
Flowkit Explore Skill v2 is a Flowkit-specific Author guidance layer on top of OpenSpec explore and defines explore.md as the reviewable Explore output.
The Flowkit Explore Skill v2 is not yet vendored into the current flowkit-next repository; this Run uses it as external bootstrap guidance only.

This environment could not execute the packaged OpenSpec CLI because the official npm tgz does not bundle node_modules; scaffold bytes must be validated by the local exact 1.10.0 runtime when applying the payload.
Historical XDesk-xx/flowkit evidence is reference material only and does not become flowkit-next authority.
